name: Sumi Ink Sky Scrolls
description: Giant calligraphy brushstrokes painting themselves across the sky — each stroke becoming a mountain, river, or forest that exists only while the ink is wet.
prompt: Giant sumi ink calligraphy brushstrokes painting themselves across twilight sky, each stroke materializing into landscape — mountains, rivers, bamboo forests, pagodas — existing only while ink is wet, monochrome with single accent color (cinnabar red), rice paper sky texture, zen aesthetic, dynamic motion captured, 8k
caption: Existence is just ink that hasn't dried yet. 🖌️🏔️
